name: Setsuna
source:
Sirus Wisla's right hand woman, despite her demi-human status.
Why she, a demi-human, actively supports the Republic of Wisla, as well as why Sirus keeps her by his side, are just two of the many mysteries surrounding this woman.
While there are more to her feelings for Sirus than just loyalty, they don't appear to be mutual.

[From Frontwing's [url=https://www.facebook.com/FrontwingINT/]official Facebook page[/url]]
